rationale: The price has failed to hold the 9-EMA ($13.27) and is currently trading below both the 9-EMA and the entry price, indicating a loss of the immediate momentum that justified the entry. Given the proximity to the invalidation level ($13.17) and the lack of follow-through after the initial breakout, exiting now preserves capital and avoids a stop-out if the price tests the VWAP support at $13.22.
